|game_text=If you deployed only 1 (non-[Coruscant], non-[Special Edition]) location, play this Epic Event instead of a Starting Interrupt. Deploy Battle Plan, Do, Or Do Not, and an [Immune to Alter] Effect from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Insert cards and your [[Permanent Weapon]] and [Maintenance] cards are lost. You go first. Choose one:<br />'''Jedi:''' Deploy on table. At start of your turn, turn all cards here face up. During your turn, may use 1 Force for each card stacked here to stack a card from hand face up here. Instead of using X Force, may turn X cards here face down.<br />'''Agent of Evil:''' take Luke and a site into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Deploy on opponent’s side of table; their total battle and duel destiny is +3.
